scenarios.name: Inspect the File menu from Home

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` has been opened in the MCAD Software and is listed in recent documents
Home is active with at least one recent document visible
a vertical list of file commands opens over Home
a recent-documents region is shown beside the command list
Save As, document properties and Print appear muted
the Home recent-documents view remains visible around the menu
